label: Readwise Book
description: A source book / article / tweet / podcast in Readwise — the parent that highlights belong to. One row per Readwise `user_book_id`; matches Readwise's `/export/` book payload fields verbatim for upstream fidelity.

title.description: Book / article / tweet title (maps to Readwise `title`).

category.description: Source category — books | articles | tweets | podcasts (maps to Readwise `category`).

readwise_source.description: How the highlight was imported — e.g. `kindle`, `instapaper`, `manual` (maps to Readwise `source`). Field-renamed to avoid shadowing the first-class `source` column on the items table.

source_url.description: Stable URL of the original source.

cover_image_url.description: Book / article cover image (maps to Readwise `cover_image_url`).

num_highlights.description: Number of highlights Readwise had captured for this source at sync time.

updated.description: Readwise `updated` timestamp — when the book metadata last changed upstream.
